info.name: Mistria API
info.description:
Full endpoint collection for the Mistria travel platform API.

Auth: call "Auth & Users > Login" first - its test script auto-saves the JWT into the {{token}} collection variable, which every authenticated request sends as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (set at the collection level). Requests under "Website (Public)" and a few others (Login, Forgot/Reset Password, Logout, Dashboard Statistics) override this with no auth.

Base URL: set the {{baseUrl}} collection variable to your environment (e.g. http://localhost:5000 for local dev, or the deployed API URL). Do not commit real credentials into this collection - the Login body uses a placeholder password.

File uploads: form-data "file" fields are left empty (`src: []`) - attach a real file in the Postman UI before sending. For multi-file/multi-value fields (Images, Included, Excluded, ItineraryDayImages, ...), add more rows with the same key.

A roundup of must-see Egyptian landmarks.

request.description: Convenience endpoint: creates the Blog and all of its initial BlogSub sections in a single atomic request, so the whole post can be written and published in one go. SubImages/SubImageIndexes are optional and work like ItineraryDayImages on Travel Programs: omit both entirely for subs with no images, or attach only the subs you want an image for - SubImageIndexes[i] says which sub (by position in SubsJson) SubImages[i] belongs to. Any sub whose index is not listed is created with no image (this example gives sub 0 and sub 2 an image while leaving sub 1 without one). Sections created here can still be edited/deleted individually afterwards via the Blog Sub endpoints below.
